description: Use for "what are my competitors doing?". Returns recent changes in the brand's chosen competitors' Meta ads as conclusions: what changed, what it means for this brand and what to do (or that nothing is needed). We study their ads so the user does not have to; competitor ads themselves are not shown. Competitors are set in the Run1Ads app.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.

name: get_competitor_changes
